ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 30% high-intensity (off-white) distribution across visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark region centrally and extending toward lobes; high-intensity white pigmentation concentrated at the distal tips with interspersed small, low-intensity circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped median notch with a wide angle and moderate depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary from the median notch to both tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent convex sweep; leading edge shows a slight convexity towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular and ring-like white scars (rosettes) distributed across the dark central and right lobe regions; small dark circular spots visible on the white distal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear marks and rake-like patterns visible, particularly a prominent cluster on the left inner lobe and several smaller isolated marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of barnacles at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive surface scarring including circular ring marks and linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Clusters of barnacles visible as textured protrusions at the extreme distal points of the fluke tips.
